configurations.//: Attach only -- no command on purpose. This app is started by bbt (or start.cmd) and keeps its port in data/settings.json, not in a PORT env var; letting the preview harness launch its own copy would put two servers on the same data/ directory, where they clobber each other's board.json and fight over server.pid. Start it with `bbt start` first, then preview attaches here.
